name: Tomb of the Unknown Gold
author: Kapuniai42
description:
The year is 1925, you are an archaeologist that has discovered a Map from 4,000 BCE, mentioning a pyramid in Egypt that holds a ton of Egyptian Gold! Can you find the lost Gold? Will you make it out alive? What awaits inside? 
Story: You follow the coordinates on the map. You find the pyramid and head inside to discover bodies of different explores who didn’t make it, wondering if you will make it out alive? Suddenly the front entrance closes, you begin to panic, you see a horde of undead mummies coming for you, you run to the nearest exit!
Aesthetics: Tomb of the Unknown Gold is an Endless Runner that is emotionally Captivating with never seen before Role Play Elements that make the game Adventurous and Ambitious! The game will Always begin with the player roaming the desert looting temples & Pyramids While Being chased down my Mummies and their Undead Dogs.
